paragraphs.en:
Good morning, I’m filling in for Spencer Jakab. The Middle East continues to dictate sentiment across markets. Pressure on global bond yields is easing, oil prices are down and stock futures are up after a handful of ships reportedly passed through the Strait of Hormuz overnight. President Trump suggested yesterday that the war with Iran could end “very quickly,” while also warning that the U.S. could resume military strikes.



 



​📈 Follow our live markets data and coverage.



 


-	Last	Chg%


↑ S&P 500 FUTURES

	7,405.00	+0.37%


↑ DJIA FUTURES

	49,538.00	+0.16%


↑ NASDAQ 100 FUTURES

	29,133.00	+0.72%


↓ U.S. 10 YEAR TREASURY NOTE

	4.64	-0.58


↓ CRUDE OIL

	102.29	-1.79%


 


5/20/2026, 6:27:39 AM ET


 


 


 


Memory sticks


 



How much are AI’s leading spenders actually buying?



 



That may seem like a ridiculous question, given that capital expenditures by Meta Platforms, Microsoft, Google parent Alphabet and Amazon.com are expected to total around $725 billion this year.



 



But it is an increasingly relevant one. AI’s big bucks go mostly toward computing gear like chips and servers in data centers. Recently, growth in spending on all that stuff has been driven by higher prices rather than more deployments of equipment.



 



Should that trend persist, it could come to bite suppliers including chip giant Nvidia, which reports quarterly results after the bell today. Analysts expect nearly $79 billion of sales, per FactSet, a 79% year-on-year increase. Profits are expected to more than double for the fiscal period ended in late April.



 



Nvidia can insulate itself from cost inflation by expanding offerings that don’t require as much in-demand memory, by passing on higher prices to customers and by inking longer-term deals with its own suppliers at lower prices. The company had $95.2 billion of purchase commitments at the end of its last reported quarter, reflecting how it is already using its financial muscle to control its supply chain. Ultimately, though, Nvidia benefits most when it sells more of its chips and associated equipment.



 



Computer memory has been the bugbear on pricing lately. Demand for advanced memory modules in the most cutting-edge AI-computing setups far outstrips supply. That is great for memory producers like Micron Technology, whose stock is up 150% this year. Not so much for Nvidia, which has to try to keep its margins from being eroded, or for buyers like the big tech companies that have to pay a premium.



 



Microsoft recently raised its capital spending to $190 billion this year, a total that finance chief Amy Hood said included $25 billion “from the impact of higher component pricing”—a shorthand largely for the memory crunch. Google cited similar reasoning behind a recent $5 billion increase in its capex range.



 



Overall, the four big AI spenders plan to grow outlays by around 88% this year. If analyst forecasts pan out, though, the increase next year will be far more modest, rising 10% to around $801 billion—an illustration of how AI is testing even the deepest Big Tech pockets. 



 



Of course, that is still a ton of money. Forecasts could easily move higher as next year approaches, too. But if much of the 2027 increase is because of higher costs, it suggests the pace of the AI infrastructure build-out is slowing in real terms.



 



Any such slowdown won’t show up in the company’s quarterly results today, but Nvidia and its peers will eventually feel the impact.



 





 




 


 



This is an edition of the Markets A.M. newsletter, preparing you for the trading day ahead with expert insight into the companies and industries set to move markets. If you’re not subscribed, sign up here.



 


 


 


Stocks I’m Watching


 



🔎Nvidia: The chip maker and world’s most valuable company by market cap is set to report earnings after markets close. Shares rose before the opening bell.

记忆棒

人工智能的领先支出者实际购买了多少？

考虑到Meta Platforms、微软、谷歌母公司Alphabet和亚马逊今年的资本支出总额预计约为7250亿美元，这似乎是个荒谬的问题。

但这正变得越来越相关。人工智能的巨额资金主要流向数据中心内的芯片和服务器等计算设备。近期，这类支出的增长更多是由价格上涨而非设备部署增加所驱动。

如果这一趋势持续，可能会冲击包括芯片巨头英伟达在内的供应商。该公司今日盘后公布季度业绩。根据FactSet数据，分析师预计其销售额近790亿美元，同比增长79%；截至4月底的财季利润预计将增长逾一倍。

英伟达可以通过扩展对高需求内存依赖较小的产品、将更高成本转嫁给客户，以及与自身供应商签订更长期的低价协议来抵御成本通胀。在上一个报告季度末，该公司拥有952亿美元的采购承诺，反映出其已利用财务实力控制供应链。但归根结底，英伟达在销售更多芯片及相关设备时受益最大。

近期，计算机内存成为定价难题。在最尖端的AI计算设备中，对先进内存模块的需求远超供应。这对美光科技等内存生产商极为有利——其股价今年已上涨150%。但对英伟达而言则不然，它必须努力防止利润率被侵蚀；对大型科技公司等买家来说，它们不得不支付溢价。

微软近期将今年资本支出提高至1900亿美元，财务总监艾米·胡德表示，其中250亿美元“来自零部件定价上涨的影响”——这主要是内存短缺的体现。谷歌也以类似理由将其资本支出区间上调了50亿美元。

总体而言，四大AI支出者计划今年将支出增加约88%。然而，如果分析师预测成真，明年的增幅将温和得多，仅增长10%至约8010亿美元——这说明了AI正在考验甚至最雄厚的大型科技公司的财力。

当然，这仍是一笔巨款。随着明年临近，预测值也容易进一步上调。但如果2027年的增长主要源于成本上升，则意味着AI基础设施建设的实际速度正在放缓。

任何此类放缓都不会体现在公司今日的季度业绩中，但英伟达及其同行最终将感受到影响。

Memory sticks


 



How much are AI’s leading spenders actually buying?



 



That may seem like a ridiculous question, given that capital expenditures by Meta Platforms, Microsoft, Google parent Alphabet and Amazon.com are expected to total around $725 billion this year.



 



But it is an increasingly relevant one. AI’s big bucks go mostly toward computing gear like chips and servers in data centers. Recently, growth in spending on all that stuff has been driven by higher prices rather than more deployments of equipment.



 



Should that trend persist, it could come to bite suppliers including chip giant Nvidia, which reports quarterly results after the bell today. Analysts expect nearly $79 billion of sales, per FactSet, a 79% year-on-year increase. Profits are expected to more than double for the fiscal period ended in late April.



 



Nvidia can insulate itself from cost inflation by expanding offerings that don’t require as much in-demand memory, by passing on higher prices to customers and by inking longer-term deals with its own suppliers at lower prices. The company had $95.2 billion of purchase commitments at the end of its last reported quarter, reflecting how it is already using its financial muscle to control its supply chain. Ultimately, though, Nvidia benefits most when it sells more of its chips and associated equipment.



 



Computer memory has been the bugbear on pricing lately. Demand for advanced memory modules in the most cutting-edge AI-computing setups far outstrips supply. That is great for memory producers like Micron Technology, whose stock is up 150% this year. Not so much for Nvidia, which has to try to keep its margins from being eroded, or for buyers like the big tech companies that have to pay a premium.



 



Microsoft recently raised its capital spending to $190 billion this year, a total that finance chief Amy Hood said included $25 billion “from the impact of higher component pricing”—a shorthand largely for the memory crunch. Google cited similar reasoning behind a recent $5 billion increase in its capex range.



 



Overall, the four big AI spenders plan to grow outlays by around 88% this year. If analyst forecasts pan out, though, the increase next year will be far more modest, rising 10% to around $801 billion—an illustration of how AI is testing even the deepest Big Tech pockets. 



 



Of course, that is still a ton of money. Forecasts could easily move higher as next year approaches, too. But if much of the 2027 increase is because of higher costs, it suggests the pace of the AI infrastructure build-out is slowing in real terms.



 



Any such slowdown won’t show up in the company’s quarterly results today, but Nvidia and its peers will eventually feel the impact.

For investors, this highlights regional divergence in consumer discretionary spending on pets, suggesting premium pet product and service providers may see stronger demand in Western markets.
articles.recap_zh: 根据美国银行2026年1月至4月的信用卡消费数据，美国西部地区的宠物支出显著高于全国平均水平，其中西雅图的月均宠物消费（含宠物店、兽医及保险）比全国均值高出约23%。相比之下，亚特兰大、达拉斯和奥兰多等南部城市的宠物支出低于全国水平，主要受当地较低生活成本影响。这一区域差异提示投资者关注西部宠物经济相关公司（如宠物零售商和保险商）的潜在增长机会。

articles.title: Tech Crescendo

paragraphs.en:
Sponsored by 



What Happened in Markets Today



The tech-powered bull market is hitting a crescendo, with blockbuster IPOs looking increasingly likely. The prospectus filing for SpaceX's highly anticipated public debut could come as soon as today. Meanwhile, OpenAI has been working with bankers to prepare its own IPO filing in the coming days or weeks, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.

Stocks moved higher and the global bond selloff took a breather as investors latched onto hopeful signs from the Iran talks. The S&P 500 rose 1.1%, the Nasdaq gained 1.5%, and the Dow added 645 points, or 1.3%.

Benchmark U.S. crude oil prices declined 5.7%. President Trump told reporters that talks with Iran were advancing and three oil tankers had successfully transited the Strait of Hormuz.

Yields on government bonds in the U.S., Germany, and Japan all ticked lower Wednesday, though they remain elevated. Bonds have sold off across the board in recent days on fears that sticky inflation will force central banks to ratchet up interest rates.

All eyes are on Nvidia as it reports earnings after the closing bell. Nvidia shares were trading down slightly after reporting revenue and earnings that beat consensus forecasts. Its stock price has actually fallen the day after its last three quarterly reports, notes Dan Gallagher, a columnist for Heard on the Street.
paragraphs.zh:
**赞助内容**

**今日市场动态**

科技股引领的牛市正渐入高潮，重磅IPO频现曙光。SpaceX备受瞩目的公开上市招股说明书最早可能于今日提交。与此同时，据《华尔街日报》周三报道，OpenAI已与银行家合作，准备在未来数日或数周内提交其IPO申请。

股市走高，全球债券抛售潮暂歇，投资者从伊朗谈判中捕捉到积极信号。标普500指数上涨1.1%，纳斯达克指数上涨1.5%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨645点，涨幅1.3%。

美国基准原油价格下跌5.7%。特朗普总统向记者表示，与伊朗的谈判取得进展，三艘油轮已成功通过霍尔木兹海峡。

美国、德国和日本国债收益率周三均小幅回落，但仍处于高位。近日，由于市场担忧顽固通胀将迫使各国央行加息，债券遭遇全面抛售。

市场目光聚焦英伟达，该公司将在收盘后公布财报。英伟达股价在营收和利润均超出市场共识预期后小幅走低。据《华尔街日报》专栏作家丹·加拉格尔指出，该公司股价在过去三次季报发布后的次日均出现下跌。

articles.recap_en: Morgan Stanley’s midyear 2026 outlook is constructive on risk assets, particularly U.S. equities, driven by AI infrastructure investment and resilient earnings, despite headwinds from higher energy prices and geopolitical volatility. Key data points include a growth slowdown in H2 2026 due to an oil supply shock, with a recovery expected in 2027, while credit markets face pressure from increased corporate bond issuance. The implication is to stay bullish on equities, as AI’s impact on earnings is underestimated, but remain cautious on credit and luxury sectors amid uneven consumer sentiment and innovation risks.
articles.recap_zh: 摩根士丹利2026年中投资展望认为，尽管地缘政治风险和油价冲击导致下半年增长放缓，但AI基础设施投资仍支撑风险资产，尤其是美股。报告指出，企业债券发行增加可能给信贷市场带来压力，而奢侈品行业在两年收缩后趋于稳定，但全面复苏尚需时日。建议投资者保持建设性态度，关注AI对盈利的持续推动，同时警惕能源价格和地缘波动带来的市场波动。

articles.recap_en: The article highlights how trade finance instruments, specifically letters of credit, are enabling critical infrastructure projects in Africa, such as Dar es Salaam’s new bus rapid transit system in Tanzania and the Koloma Administrative City in Guinea. These partnerships, involving local banks and export credit agencies like UK Export Finance with Deutsche Bank, demonstrate how structured finance can unlock urban development and government efficiency. For investors, this underscores the growing role of trade finance as a de-risking tool in emerging markets, particularly for long-term infrastructure and sovereign-backed projects.
articles.recap_zh: 这篇报道指出，贸易融资正通过信用证等工具为非洲基建项目提供关键支持，例如坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆的快速公交系统，以及几内亚政府与英国出口融资署及德意志银行合作开发的科洛马行政城项目。后者通过将多个政府部门集中办公，旨在提升效率、透明度和长期财政节约。这表明，贸易融资不仅缓解了非洲基建的资金瓶颈，也为国际银行和出口机构创造了参与新兴市场长期增长的投资机会。

articles.title: Peace Signs

paragraphs.en:
Sponsored by 



What Happened in Markets Today



Stocks rose amid signs that progress is being made to resolve the nearly three-month old war between the U.S. and Iran. The S&P 500 gained 0.2%, the Dow added 0.6%, and the Nasdaq advanced 0.1%. Brent crude fell.

Nvidia closed 1.8% lower. The chip giant reported record sales and income that beat analyst expectations, driven by demand for data-center computing and the rise of AI agents. But there's already a lot of optimism baked in. Nvidia’s stock is up 67% over the past 12 months, making it the largest publicly listed company in the world, with a market value of nearly $5.4 trillion.

Spotify jumped 13%. The music streaming company said it plans to roll out an AI tool allowing users to make covers and remixes of songs from Universal Music Group artists.The company also gave a bullish 2030 outlook.

Walmart said sales grew in its most recent quarter as shoppers looked for value and bought more online. Still, shares fell about 7% after the company left its financial expectations for the full year unchanged.

SoftBank shares surged nearly 20% in Japan. OpenAI, one of its key investments, is preparing to file for an IPO as soon as this week.
paragraphs.zh:
**市场今日动态**

股市上涨，因有迹象显示美国与伊朗之间持续近三个月的战争正取得进展。标普500指数上涨0.2%，道琼斯指数上涨0.6%，纳斯达克指数上涨0.1%。布伦特原油下跌。

英伟达收盘下跌1.8%。这家芯片巨头公布的营收和利润创下纪录，超出分析师预期，主要受数据中心计算需求及人工智能代理兴起推动。但市场已提前消化大量乐观情绪。英伟达股价过去12个月累计上涨67%，成为全球市值最大的上市公司，市值接近5.4万亿美元。

Spotify大涨13%。这家音乐流媒体公司表示，计划推出一款人工智能工具，允许用户对环球音乐集团艺人的歌曲进行翻唱和混音。该公司还给出了看涨的2030年展望。

沃尔玛表示，由于消费者追求性价比并增加线上购物，其最近一个季度销售额实现增长。不过，该公司在维持全年财务预期不变后，股价下跌约7%。

软银股价在日本飙升近20%。其重要投资对象之一OpenAI最早将于本周提交首次公开募股申请。

What Happened in Markets Today



Stocks rose amid signs that progress is being made to resolve the nearly three-month old war between the U.S. and Iran. The S&P 500 gained 0.2%, the Dow added 0.6%, and the Nasdaq advanced 0.1%. Brent crude fell.

Nvidia closed 1.8% lower. The chip giant reported record sales and income that beat analyst expectations, driven by demand for data-center computing and the rise of AI agents. Nvidia’s stock is up 67% over the past 12 months, making it the largest publicly listed company in the world, with a market value of nearly $5.4 trillion.

Spotify jumped 13%. The music streaming company said it plans to roll out an AI tool allowing users to make covers and remixes of songs from Universal Music Group artists.The company also gave a bullish 2030 outlook.

Walmart said sales grew in its most recent quarter as shoppers looked for value and bought more online. Still, shares fell about 7% after the company left its financial expectations for the full year unchanged.

SoftBank shares surged nearly 20% in Japan. OpenAI, one of its key investments, is preparing to file for an IPO as soon as this week.

Confidence game


 



Markets have gotten used to dismissing consumers’ fears about the economy like a passing tantrum. They should listen more carefully this time around.



 



The University of Michigan will release the final May reading of its consumer sentiment index today, and the Conference Board will follow with an update to its consumer confidence index next Tuesday.



 



Perhaps some investors will shrug if these measures show worsening sentiment. One reason: as inflation surged in 2022, a sharp downturn in sentiment wasn’t followed by big, negative changes in consumer behavior.



 



Consumers certainly didn’t like inflation. But they made the needed adjustments, grumbled, and kept spending. The phenomenon became known by its own portmanteau, “vibecession.”



 



When it was released in early May, the Michigan survey’s preliminary reading hit a fresh record low against a backdrop of rising gas prices. Those continue to climb, so it’s somewhat natural to again attribute consumers’ sour attitude to inflation.



 



But these bad vibes may not be the same bad vibes of four years ago.



 



Back then, some interesting questions in Michigan’s broader survey, beyond the index, didn’t show such extreme pessimism. That included views on making real, inflation-adjusted income gains over the next five years, and on the prospect of keeping a job over that time frame. In 2022, people were more confident of not losing a job over that span than they had been in the late 1990s.



 



Some of those readings for May and April haven’t been released yet. But people’s confidence on those five-year measures has been falling alongside the headline sentiment index. The most recent data for respondents’ five-year job-loss fears, from March, was near its all-time high.



 



Likewise, the Conference Board consumer confidence index’s “vibes” weren’t close to record lows in 2022. That headline index incorporates questions about employment conditions and family income. Recent readings, though, have been below 2022 levels.



 



Another measure, from the New York Fed’s Survey of Consumer Expectations, is close to its lows for respondents’ expectation that if they lost their job, they would find another within three months.



 



It is one thing to be unhappy about inflation when you have to, say, seek out a better job, or a second job, to keep up. It is another thing to worry that you won’t even have those options.



 



“The recent decline in sentiment is more driven by weaker economic fundamentals,” says Joseph Briggs, co-head of the global economics research team at Goldman Sachs. He said that points to a likely decline in consumer spending growth in the back half of this year.



 



Consumers aren’t necessarily right about their job prospects. They weren’t entirely right about inflation. But fears about employment could motivate people to start making more cautious decisions that ripple for lenders, retailers, restaurants and the broader economy. 



 



Consumer confidence can still be a warning of things to come.

信心游戏

市场已习惯于将消费者对经济的担忧视为一时闹剧而不予理会。但这一次，他们应当更仔细地倾听。

密歇根大学将于今日发布5月消费者信心指数的终值，而世界大型企业联合会则将于下周二公布其消费者信心指数的更新数据。

如果这些指标显示情绪恶化，一些投资者或许会不以为意。原因之一是：2022年通胀飙升时，情绪急剧下滑并未引发消费者行为的重大负面变化。

消费者当然不喜欢通胀。但他们做出了必要的调整，发发牢骚，然后继续消费。这种现象被冠以一个合成词：“氛围衰退”。

5月初发布时，密歇根调查的初值在汽油价格上涨的背景下触及历史新低。汽油价格仍在攀升，因此将消费者的悲观情绪再次归因于通胀，多少有些顺理成章。

但如今的这种“坏氛围”可能与四年前不尽相同。

彼时，密歇根更广泛调查中的一些有趣问题——超出指数本身——并未显示出如此极端的悲观情绪。这包括对未来五年实现经通胀调整的实际收入增长的看法，以及在此期间保住工作的前景。2022年，人们对在此期间不失业的信心甚至高于上世纪90年代末。

5月和4月的部分读数尚未公布。但人们对这些五年期指标的信心已随总体情绪指数一同下降。关于受访者五年内失业恐惧的最新数据（截至3月）接近历史最高水平。

同样，世界大型企业联合会消费者信心指数的“氛围”在2022年也远未触及历史低点。该总体指数纳入了关于就业状况和家庭收入的问题。然而，近期的读数已低于2022年的水平。

纽约联储消费者预期调查中的另一项指标显示，受访者对于失业后三个月内找到新工作的预期接近低点。

当你不得不，比如说，寻找一份更好的工作或兼职来维持生计而对通胀感到不满，这是一回事。担心自己连这些选择都没有，则是另一回事。

高盛全球经济研究团队联席主管约瑟夫·布里格斯表示：“近期情绪下滑更多是由疲弱的经济基本面驱动的。”他指出，这预示着今年下半年消费者支出增长可能放缓。

消费者对自身就业前景的看法未必正确。他们对通胀的看法也并非完全准确。但对就业的担忧可能会促使人们开始做出更为谨慎的决定，这些决定将波及贷款机构、零售商、餐饮业乃至更广泛的经济领域。

消费者信心仍可成为未来事态的预警信号。

↗️ IBM、GlobalFoundries、D-Wave Quantum：量子计算公司股价在盘前交易中上涨，延续了周四的涨势。此前美国商务部宣布提供20亿美元拨款（包括股权交易），以推动该技术的发展。

↗️ IMAX：据《华尔街日报》报道，这家高端银幕公司正在探索出售事宜。股价在盘后交易中上涨。

↘️ 历峰集团：这家瑞士奢侈品公司核心珠宝业务（包括卡地亚和梵克雅宝等品牌）的季度销售额增长了16%，尽管奢侈品行业面临挑战。股价在瑞士下跌。

↘️ Deckers Outdoor：该公司旗下Hoka鞋类品牌的需求推动销售额上升，帮助抵消了近期季度的关税及其他挑战。股价在盘前交易中回落。

Markets have gotten used to dismissing consumers’ fears about the economy like a passing tantrum. They should listen more carefully this time around.
sections.zh: 市场已习惯于将消费者对经济的担忧视为一时的情绪波动而不予理会。这一次，它们应当更仔细地倾听。

sections.en: The University of Michigan will release the final May reading of its consumer sentiment index today, and the Conference Board will follow with an update to its consumer confidence index next Tuesday.
sections.zh: 密歇根大学将于今日发布5月消费者信心指数的终值，世界大型企业联合会则将于下周二公布其消费者信心指数的更新数据。

sections.en: Perhaps some investors will shrug if these measures show worsening sentiment. One reason: as inflation surged in 2022, a sharp downturn in sentiment wasn’t followed by big, negative changes in consumer behavior.
sections.zh: 或许部分投资者会对这些指标所反映出的情绪恶化不以为意。原因之一在于：2022年通胀飙升时，情绪急剧下滑并未引发消费者行为出现重大负面转变。

sections.en: Consumers certainly didn’t like inflation. But they made the needed adjustments, grumbled, and kept spending. The phenomenon became known by its own portmanteau, “vibecession.”
sections.zh: 消费者当然不喜欢通胀。但他们做出了必要的调整，一边抱怨，一边继续消费。这一现象被冠以了一个合成词：“氛围衰退”。

sections.en: When it was released in early May, the Michigan survey’s preliminary reading hit a fresh record low against a backdrop of rising gas prices. Those continue to climb, so it’s somewhat natural to again attribute consumers’ sour attitude to inflation.
sections.zh: 5月初发布的密歇根消费者信心指数初值在油价上涨的背景下创下新低。由于油价持续攀升，将消费者悲观情绪再次归因于通胀也属自然。

articles.recap_en: The core thesis is that current consumer pessimism is fundamentally different from the 2022 "vibecession," driven not just by inflation but by rising fears of job loss. Key data shows the University of Michigan sentiment index hit a fresh record low in early May, while the New York Fed’s survey on re-employment expectations is near its lows and the Conference Board index has fallen below 2022 levels. Goldman Sachs economist Joseph Briggs warns this points to a likely decline in consumer spending growth in the second half of the year, which could negatively impact lenders, retailers, and restaurants.
articles.recap_zh: 根据《华尔街日报》文章，当前消费者信心下滑的核心担忧已从通胀转向就业安全，2022年“氛围衰退”时消费者虽对通胀不满但仍持续消费，而如今密歇根大学5月消费者信心指数初值创历史新低，且纽约联储调查显示消费者对失业后三个月内找到新工作的预期接近历史低点。高盛经济学家Joseph Briggs指出，这种由基本面疲软驱动的情绪恶化，可能预示今年下半年消费支出增长放缓，进而对零售商、餐饮业及整体经济产生连锁影响。

articles.title: Warsh Era Begins

paragraphs.en:
Sponsored by 



What Happened in Markets Today



U.S. stocks climbed, bolstered by continued enthusiasm surrounding AI, aerospace and other emerging tech. The S&P 500 advanced 0.4%, the Dow gained 0.6%, and the Nasdaq edged up 0.2%. Indexes in Asia and Europe also climbed.

Kevin Warsh was sworn in as the nation’s top central banker. In remarks at today's swearing in ceremony, President Trump briefly endorsed Fed independence. But he quickly pivoted to arguments for why the Fed should view rising inflation as a one-off and keep rates lower to give the economy room to run.

Investors' optimism comes despite an uncertain backdrop surrounding the Middle East conflict, with media reports about a potential deal between the U.S. and Iran sending oil prices and government bonds swinging in recent days. Brent crude futures climbed 0.9% to $103.54 a barrel on Friday, while the 10-year Treasury yield edged lower to 4.57%.

Republicans are feeling the gloomiest they have felt about the economy since President Trump returned to the White House, according to the University of Michigan. Consumer sentiment among Republicans declined to 84.6 in May, the lowest reading of the current Trump administration, the school’s surveys of consumers showed Friday.

今日市场动态

美国股市上涨，受人工智能、航空航天及其他新兴科技领域持续热潮推动。标普500指数上涨0.4%，道琼斯指数上涨0.6%，纳斯达克指数微涨0.2%。亚洲和欧洲股指亦同步走高。

凯文·沃什宣誓就任美国最高央行行长。在今日就职典礼的讲话中，特朗普总统简短表态支持美联储独立性，但随即转向论述为何美联储应将当前通胀上升视为一次性现象，并维持低利率以给经济留出运行空间。

投资者的乐观情绪并未受中东冲突不确定背景影响——尽管近日媒体关于美伊潜在协议的报道导致油价与政府债券波动。周五布伦特原油期货上涨0.9%至每桶103.54美元，10年期美债收益率微降至4.57%。

密歇根大学数据显示，共和党人对经济的悲观情绪达到特朗普总统重返白宫以来最高水平。该大学周五公布的消费者调查显示，共和党人5月消费者信心指数降至84.6，为特朗普本届政府任内最低值。

articles.recap_en: **Recap:** The core takeaway is that markets rallied on AI and tech optimism despite a mixed macro backdrop, with the S&P 500 up 0.4% and Brent crude rising to $103.54. The key political development is Kevin Warsh being sworn in as Fed Chair, with President Trump publicly pressuring him to treat inflation as transitory and keep rates low. For investors, the tension between Trump’s push for lower rates and Warsh’s independence is a critical risk, especially as Republican consumer sentiment hit a Trump-era low of 84.6 and oil prices remain volatile amid potential U.S.-Iran deal talks.
articles.recap_zh: 美国股市在AI、航空航天等新兴科技热情推动下上涨，标普500涨0.4%，纳斯达克涨0.2%；新任美联储主席凯文·沃什宣誓就职，特朗普总统虽短暂支持美联储独立性，但随即施压其将通胀视为一次性现象并维持低利率。尽管中东冲突导致油价波动（布伦特原油升至103.54美元/桶），投资者仍保持乐观；但密歇根大学数据显示，5月共和党消费者信心降至84.6，为特朗普重返白宫以来最低，反映党派经济悲观情绪加剧。市场影响上，需关注沃什能否顶住政治压力维持紧缩立场，以及地缘政治风险对能源和债券市场的持续扰动。

articles.title: Daily Insights: AI substitutes tasks, not entire jobs

paragraphs.en:
AI substitutes tasks, not entire jobs




Daily Insights | 22 May 2026




 

The number of jobs in the AI augmentation category is significantly higher than the number of jobs that have automation potential

Global estimates for jobs with AI augmentation and automation potential as share of total employment







Source: ILO – CC BY 4.0 - Gmyrek, P., Berg, J., Kamiński, K., Konopczyński, F., Ładna, A., Nafradi, B., Rosłaniec, K., Troszyński, M. (2025). Generative AI and Jobs: A Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure, ILO Working Paper 140 (Geneva, ILO). Doi:10.54394/HETP0387; BofA Global Research

Note: Based on microdata for 59 countries. Augmentation potential refers to the likelihood that AI will assist humans rather than replace them. Automation potential refers to the likelihood that AI can fully replace a task or job.

BANK OF AMERICA INSTITUTE

As AI becomes more integrated in the workplace, BofA Global Research expects tasks to be reallocated within occupations rather than entire professions being displaced. Data from the International Labour Organization (ILO) supports this view, suggesting that around 13% of global employment has augmentation potential, compared with just 2.3% at risk of automation.

Historically, breakthrough technologies have often bolted onto existing processes before reorganizing them. Electrification, for instance, first powered old factory layouts and only later enabled redesign. BofA Global Research expects a similar two-stage path with generative AI.

Dive deeper into our publication: Adaptability is the new job security: AI and the future of work. Or, if you’re looking for a listen this Memorial Day weekend, tune in to Global Research Unlocked, where BofA Global Research analysts unpack their latest AI insights.

paragraphs.zh:
AI替代的是任务，而非整个岗位

每日洞察 | 2026年5月22日

 

 

具备AI增强潜力的岗位数量显著高于存在自动化风险的岗位

全球范围内，具有AI增强与自动化潜力的岗位占总就业人数的比例估算

来源：国际劳工组织（ILO）– CC BY 4.0 - Gmyrek, P., Berg, J., Kamiński, K., Konopczyński, F., Ładna, A., Nafradi, B., Rosłaniec, K., Troszyński, M. (2025). 《生成式AI与就业：职业暴露度精细化全球指数》，ILO工作论文第140号（日内瓦：国际劳工组织）。DOI:10.54394/HETP0387；美银全球研究

注：基于59个国家的微观数据。增强潜力指AI辅助人类而非替代人类的可能性；自动化潜力指AI完全替代某项任务或岗位的可能性。

美国银行研究所

随着AI在工作场所的日益融入，美银全球研究预计，任务将在职业内部重新分配，而非整个职业被取代。国际劳工组织的数据支持这一观点：全球约13%的就业岗位具有增强潜力，而仅有2.3%面临自动化风险。

从历史看，突破性技术往往先依附于现有流程，而后再对其进行重组。例如，电气化最初只是为旧工厂布局提供动力，后来才推动设计变革。美银全球研究预计，生成式AI也将经历类似的“两步走”路径。

深入了解我们的报告：《适应性是新的工作保障：AI与未来工作》。若您想在阵亡将士纪念日周末收听，请关注《全球研究解锁》栏目，美银全球研究分析师将在其中解读最新的AI洞察。

articles.recap_en: BofA Global Research argues that generative AI will primarily augment tasks rather than replace entire jobs, citing ILO data showing 13% of global employment has augmentation potential versus only 2.3% at risk of automation. They draw a historical parallel to electrification, which first bolted onto existing processes before enabling full redesign, suggesting a similar two-stage adoption path for AI. The key implication is that investors should focus on companies enabling task-level AI integration and workforce adaptability, rather than betting on widespread job displacement.
articles.recap_zh: 根据美国银行2026年5月22日发布的报告，人工智能主要替代的是具体任务而非整个职业，国际劳工组织数据显示，全球约13%的就业岗位具有AI增强潜力（即AI辅助人类），而仅有2.3%的岗位面临完全被自动化取代的风险。报告指出，历史上突破性技术（如电气化）通常先嵌入现有流程，再逐步推动重组，因此生成式AI预计也将遵循类似的两阶段路径。对投资者而言，这意味着应关注那些能够通过AI提升效率的行业和公司，而非过度担忧大规模失业风险。

articles.recap_en: J.P. Morgan’s 2026 Summer Reading List highlights two key investment themes: the fragile U.S.-China trade relationship, where bilateral goods trade still totaled $414.7 billion in 2025 despite tensions, and the urgent need to modernize America’s aging energy grid, with 70% of transmission lines over 25 years old and average large transformers in service for 38 years. For investors, this suggests continued volatility in sectors exposed to tariffs and Taiwan-related risks, while presenting long-term opportunities in grid modernization, energy infrastructure, and resilience-focused technologies.
articles.recap_zh: 摩根大通2026年夏季阅读清单聚焦美中关系与电网现代化两大议题。报告指出，尽管双边关系趋紧，2025年美中商品贸易总额仍达4147亿美元，其中美国从中国进口3084亿美元；同时，美国70%的输电线路已使用超过25年，大型变压器平均服役38年，凸显电网老化问题。投资者需关注美中关税与台湾问题等压力点，以及美国能源基础设施升级带来的长期机遇与挑战。
